(B).Technical Conditions and Additional Conditions 01. The vehicle should be either brand new (ex-showroom) or in good running condition a nd shall be equipped with a valid FASTag. 02. The Service Provider shall provide air-conditioned (AC) vehicles. 03. The vehicle shall have a valid registration certificate and should not have been manuf actured prior to 01 January 2024. 04. The fuel of the hired vehicle shall be arranged and supplied by the Contractor/Firm at i ts own cost, in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Contract. 05. The cost of fuel for actual consumption up to 2,000 kilometers per month shall be bor ne by the Contractor/Firm. Any unutilized kilometers in a month shall be carried forward and added to the maximum permissible kilometers limit of the subsequent month(s) un til the expiry of the Agreement. If the cumulative running exceeds the permissible limit, the additional kilometers shall be paid for at the rate of Rs. 10/- per kilometers. For Exa mple: - If only 1,500 km are utilized in a month, the unutilized 500 km shall be carried for ward to the next month, making the permissible limit for the following month 2,500 km. Any running beyond the cumulative permissible limit shall be payable at ₹10/- per kilome ters.

06. The Vehicle shall be for the official use of Superintending Engineer, Electricity Tr ansmission Circle Jhansi or his representative. 07. The maintenance and repair costs of the vehicle shall be borne by the Contractor. In t he event of a breakdown, the Contractor shall provide an alternate vehicle within four ( 04) hours. Failing this, the vehicle shall be treated as "Not Available" and payment on a pro-rata basis shall be deducted from the Contractor's bill. 08. The log book shall be maintained by the officer using the vehicle. However, the initial and final kilometer readings of the vehicle shall be recorded and reported to the concer ned officer. The Firm shall ensure that the vehicle's odometer remains in proper workin g condition. In the event that the odometer becomes defective or non-functional, the Fir m shall have it repaired at the earliest. Failing this, a penalty of Rs. 100/- (Rupees One Hundred only) per day shall be levied until the defect is rectified. 09. In the event of any deliberate obstruction in the operation of the vehicle, or if any tam pering, irregularity, or malfunction in the speedometer/odometer is detected, the Agree ment shall be liable to termination without prior notice. 10. The vehicle shall be made available on a 24×7 basis for a period of 12 months from th e date of deployment of the vehicle or from the commencement of the Contract, whiche ver is later. 11. If, at any time, it is found that the Contractor is unable to execute the work satisfactor ily in accordance with the terms of the Agreement or the written instructions issued by t he Engineer of Contract/Engineer-in-Charge, the Contractor shall be served with a notic e of seven (07) days to improve its performance. If the Contractor fails to comply with t he instructions of the Engineer of Contract/Engineer-in-Charge or fails to improve the p erformance within the stipulated notice period, the Contract may be terminated premat urely and the Firm's EMD and PBG may be forfeited. In such an event, the Contractor sh all have no claim whatsoever arising out of the Contract, and the remaining work may b e got executed through any other agency at the risk and cost of the Contractor. 12. During emergencies or for journeys outside the Zone Headquarters, if so required, the Firm shall make the vehicle along with the driver available even during night hours or b eyond the normal duty hours. 13. The driver deployed under the Contract shall be experienced, possess a valid driving l icense, and have sound vision and mental fitness. 14. The vehicle shall be made available by the Firm on a 24×7 basis as and when require d by the concerned officer. Normally, the duty hours of the driver shall be 12 hours per day or as per the requirements of the concerned officer. The driver shall obtain permiss ion from the concerned officer before leaving duty 15. 100% payment shall be released by the Executive Engineer, Electricity Transmission Division, Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, to the Firm on a running bill basis. The Firm shall submit its monthly bills, duly supported with all requisite documents, in triplicate (03 original c opies) to the office of the Executive Engineer, Electricity Transmission Division, Jhansi, f or verification and processing of payment. In addition, the Firm shall upload the monthl y bill along with the supporting documents on the BTS portal of the concerned Unit(s). No bill shall be processed unless the prescribed documents are submitted and uploade d as required. 16. Any challan, fine, or penalty arising out of any violation of law by the hired vehicle or it s driver shall be borne solely by the Contractor/Firm, and the Department shall have no liability whatsoever in this regard.

17. The Firm shall ensure that a valid Pollution Under Control (PUC) Certificate is obtained and renewed from the competent authority from time to time. Any penalty arising due t o non-availability or expiry of the PUC Certificate shall be borne solely by the Firm. 18. The vehicle may be withdrawn by the Firm once in a month for a maximum period of t wo (02) days for routine servicing, maintenance, or repairs. However, during such perio d, the Firm shall provide an equivalent alternate vehicle along with a driver, failing whic h the vehicle shall be treated as unavailable. 19. The Contractor shall ensure that the driver deployed under this contract does not cons ume alcohol, narcotic drugs, or any other intoxicating substances while on duty and sha ll not report for duty under the influence of such substances. In case the driver is found under the influence of alcohol or any intoxicant, the Contractor shall immediately replac e the driver, failing which suitable action, including termination of the contract, may be taken by the Employer." 20. The Employer shall have the right to require police verification of the deployed driver at any time during the currency of the Contract. The Contractor shall ensure complianc e with such requirement and shall immediately replace the driver if found unsuitable ba sed on verification, without any objection. 21. The vehicle shall be comprehensively insured at all times. The Firm shall be solely res ponsible for all liabilities arising out of any accident involving the hired vehicle, includin g but not limited to third-party claims, claims by the driver, damage to the vehicle, dam age caused by or to any other vehicle, and claims relating to persons travelling in the v ehicle. This provision shall also apply to any alternate vehicle provided by the Firm und er the Contract. 22. The Contractor shall be responsible for the safety and security of the hired vehicle, th e driver, passengers travelling in the vehicle, and any material belonging to the Contrac tor pertaining to the hired vehicle. Any compensation payable under the applicable law s, including the Employees' Compensation Act, on account of injury, death, or accident i nvolving the Contractor's personnel, driver, departmental personnel, or any third party during the use of the hired vehicle shall be borne by the Contractor. UPPTCL shall not b e liable in any manner whatsoever. 23. Income Tax and other statutory deductions, as applicable under the prevailing rules a nd regulations, shall be deducted from the Contractor's monthly bills. 24. Engineer in charge of work and Engineer of Contract shall be Superintending Engineer , ETC Jhansi. 25. The Contractor/Agency shall comply with all applicable labour laws, rules, regulations, and statutory provisions of the Government of Uttar Pradesh and Government of India. The minimum wages payable to drivers shall be as per the rates notified by the Labour Commissioner from time to time, along with compliance of all statutory obligation. 26. Toll tax and parking charges actually incurred during official duty shall be reimbursed on submission of supporting documents/proof of payment. 27. Driver's night halt charges for outstation duties shall be payable at the rate of Rs. 250/ - (Rupees Two Hundred Fifty only) per night. No night halt charges shall be payable for l ocal duties. 28. Extra Kilometers run beyond 2000 Km, to be paid @ Rs. 10 per Km

(C). PRE QUALIFYING REQUIREMENT FOR TENDER 1. Minimum Experience and Performance Requirements: The Bidder should have successfully completed similar works in UPPTCL/PGCIL/Generation Plants/other State Utilities during the last three (03) years and shall meet any one of the following eligibility criteria: (A) One (01) completed work order having a value not less than 80% of the estimated bid value; OR (B) Two (02) completed work orders, each having a value not less than 50% of the esti mated bid value OR (C) Three (03) completed work orders, each having a value not less than 40% of the est imated bid value. The Bidder shall submit copies of the Agreement/Work Order along with Completion Certificates or Performance Certificates in Part-I of the tender. Such certificates shall ha ve been issued by an authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer. Experience ga ined as a Sub-contractor shall not be considered for eligibility. For the purpose of this tender, "Similar Work" shall mean providing vehic le hiring/services. 2. Financial Qualification: - a) The Minimum Average Annual Turnover (MAAT) will be taken as average of the best th ree financial years turnover out of the last five financial years preceding to the year of b id is published. In case the applicant is in existence for less than five financial years the minimum average annual turnover shall be average of the turnover of the completed n o. of financial years. The Applicant who is in existence for less than one complete finan cial year shall not be qualified. The MAAT shall not be less than estimated cost or 20 Lakhs whichever is higher. The p roject related turnover of the tendering company on standalone basis only (excluding it s Associate companies/Holding Company) shall be considered. b) The Applicant shall have Liquid Assets (Cash at Bank & Fixed Deposit) and Un-Utilized credit facility (both Fund & Non-Fund based) available from bank(s) duly certified by the bank(s) at the end of month preceding to the previous month of Tender opening, shall n ot be less than 15% of Estimated cost. c) Net worth of Applicant as per the audited financial results shall be positive on the last day of the preceding financial year. Net worth means the sum total of the paid-up share capital and free reserves (excluding reserves created out of the revaluation of assets, w rite back of depreciation provisions and amalgamation & capital reserve) net of P&LA/C (Dr. balance) and miscellaneous expenses to the extent not adjusted or written off. d) The Applicant shall furnish documentary evidence (Audited Annual Account & CA Certif icate). CA Certificate without UDIN No. will not be considered in support of the qualifyin g requirement stipulated as above: Sl.No. Financial Qualification (Rs. In Lakh.) 1 MAAT Estimated cost/ 20 Lakh

2 LA 15% of Estimated cost 3 Net Worth Positive 3. The bidder must have filed Income Tax Returns (ITR) for the last three financial years. Copies of the ITR filed along with the acknowledgement for each of the last three years must be submitted with the bid. 4. The bidder must submit Character Certificate issued by District Magistrate (DM ) valid on the date of bid submission. Copies of certificates in this respect shall be subm itted along with tender documents. 5. MSME benefits shall be admissible only to those bidders who are registered as MSME units for providing vehicle hiring/transportation services and whose Udyam Registration Certificate covers the relevant service activities. Such MSME bidders shall be eligible on ly for exemption from payment of Tender Cost and Earnest Money Deposit (EMD), as ap plicable. No exemption whatsoever shall be admissible in respect of technical qualificati ons, experience criteria, financial criteria, or any other eligibility conditions specified in the tender documents. Bidders claiming MSME benefits shall submit a valid Udyam Regi stration Certificate along with the bid. MSME registration pertaining to activities other t han vehicle hiring/transportation services shall not be considered for the purpose of ava iling such exemptions. 6. The bidder shall upload a Notary-verified Affidavit on ₹100 Non-Judicial e-stam p paper declaring that the firm has not been blacklisted or debarred by any Gover nment Department or Public Sector undertaking. A bidder who has been blacklist ed/debarred by any Government Department or PSU shall not be eligible to participate i n the tender. Any conditional revocation of blacklisting/debarment shall also render the bidder ineligible, and such bids are liable to be rejected. In case any false, incorrect, or forged statement is found in respect of the above, the bidder shall be liable for legal ac tion. Any order placed, if any, shall be liable to cancellation. 7. For quoting the rates, ‘Considerably below the estimated value of the tender’, the addi tional security amount shall be deposited at the time of execution of agreement as per GO No. 622/23-12-2012-2/Audit/08T.C.-2 dated 08.06.2012 & as per decision of the Boa rd of Directors of UPPTCL vide no. 353/CS/Transco/cSBd (53)/2017 dated 11.07.2017. af ter approval of competent committee, successful bidder shall be intimated by email/sp eed post to complete process of agreement by submission of Rs.100/- value non-judicia l stamp paper along with additional security money (if applicable) calculated on the basi s of PQR within 15 days (except Govt. declared natural calamity) from the date of issue of letter by Electricity Transmission Circle, Jhansi office, the one reminder of 7 days shal l be given, failing which successful bidder shall be debarred (izfrcfU/kr) for participating in any tender of Electricity Transmission Circle, Jhansi for next one year and earnest mo ney shall be forfeited. The additional security/performance guarantee amount shall be r eleased after expiry of satisfactory performance guarantee period. NOTE:- Bidder shall have to submit the documentary evidence in support of abo ve pre-qualifying requirement. DISCLAIMER: - Even though the bidders may meet the above qualifying criteria, they may be disqualifi ed if they have: Made misleading or false representation in the forms, statements, and
